method: Read-only FBX raw mesh bounds, topology, UV0, rigid numerical RGBA and custom-normal range checks against Blender's manifest in actual Unity-local coordinates. Asymmetric axis marker verifies the baked conversion; no prefab-node rotations are needed.
limitations: Ranges and triangle counts do not establish per-loop correspondence, silhouette quality, collision quality or performance. Authored welded boundary counts are reported separately; overlapping closed masonry pieces are not a Boolean union.
